title: Closing and Funding Prepaid Interest Terms: Day-Count Basis, Rounding and Refund Timing
content:
Prepaid per diem interest on a Closing and Funding engagement is governed by the same five terms under every closing method.

| Term | Traditional Wet | Escrow Dry-Funding | Mobile Notary | Hybrid eClosing | Remote Online Notarization | Power of Attorney | Mail-Away |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Days in the year used to compute per diem interest | 365 | 365 | 365 | 365 | 365 | 365 | 365 |
| Decimal places to which the daily interest amount is rounded | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Business days within which a prepaid interest overcharge is refunded once identified | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Interest under-collected because funding was earlier than estimated is billed after closing | No | No | No | No | No | No | No |
| Months after the disbursement month in which the first payment falls due, on the first day | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |

The column headings are the Larkspur Traditional Wet Closing, Larkspur Escrow Dry-Funding Closing, Larkspur Mobile Notary Closing, Larkspur Hybrid eClosing, Larkspur Remote Online Notarization Closing, Larkspur Power of Attorney Closing and Larkspur Mail-Away Closing.

## Basis questions

**What is the per diem day-count basis?** 365 days in the year, under every closing method; the daily interest amount is kept to 2 decimal places (the cent).

**When does the first payment fall due?** On the first day of the month 2 months after the disbursement month. A hypothetical loan disbursed on any day in March has its first payment due on 1 May.

**What is the refund timing figure?** 10 business days, the period within which a prepaid interest overcharge is refunded once identified.
